statFormulaLevel50.hp: Base + SP + 75 (equivalent to floor((2*Base + 31 + floor(EV/4))*50/100) + 60 where EV = max(0, 8*SP - 4))
statFormulaLevel50.other: floor(floor((Base + SP + 20) * NatureMod * 100) / 100) where NatureMod is 1.1 (+10%) or 0.9 (-10%)

slp.duration: sample([2, 3, 3]) -> 1/3 chance to wake up on Turn 2, 2/3 on Turn 3

newChampionsAbilities.Aura Guard: Halves damage taken from contact moves (0.5x). Signature ability of Mega Lucario Z.
newChampionsAbilities.Dragonize: Normal-type moves become Dragon-type and gain a 1.2x (4915/4096) power boost. Signature ability of Mega Feraligatr.
newChampionsAbilities.Eelevate: Grants Ground immunity (airborne) and boosts highest stat by +1 stage upon knocking out a target. Signature ability of Mega Eelektross.
newChampionsAbilities.Fire Mane: Boosts Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.5x when using Fire-type moves. Signature ability of Mega Pyroar.
newChampionsAbilities.Mega Sol: Simulates Sunny Day for the user's moves and weather-dependent effects. Signature ability of Mega Meganium.
newChampionsAbilities.Piercing Drill: Contact moves bypass Protect/Detect and deal 0.25x chip damage through protection. Signature ability of Mega Excadrill.
newChampionsAbilities.Spicy Spray: 100% chance to burn the attacker when hit by a damaging move. Signature ability of Mega Scovillain.
newChampionsAbilities.Unseen Fist (Champions): Contact moves bypass Protect/Detect and deal 0.25x damage through protection (reduced from 100% in Gen 8/9). Shared by Mega Golurk.
